exposure: International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria
two-step criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 90,140 women in Ontario, Canada who underwent a 75-g oral glucose tolerance test
finding: Women who met the IADPSG criteria for GDM but were not diagnosed with GDM based on the two-step criteria, and were therefore not treated, had an increased risk for adverse perinatal outcomes compared with women who do not have GDM.
